taxonomy.name: GCC enterprise risk taxonomy
taxonomy.description: Two-level risk taxonomy aligned to ISO 31000:2018 / COSO ERM 2017, with GCC-specific regulatory and strategic sub-categories.

domains.description_en: Risks to the achievement of strategic objectives arising from market dynamics, geopolitical developments, national programme dependencies and strategic choices.
domains.description_ar: المخاطر التي تهدد تحقيق الأهداف الاستراتيجية الناشئة عن ديناميكيات السوق والتطورات الجيوسياسية والاعتماد على البرامج الوطنية والخيارات الاستراتيجية.

children.description_en: Demand shifts, new entrants, pricing pressure, disruptive business models and loss of market share.
Regional instability, sanctions, oil price volatility, inflation and interest-rate cycles affecting the business plan.

children.name_ar: الاعتماد على البرامج الوطنية (رؤية 2030 / الأجندات الوطنية)
children.description_en: Reliance on giga-projects, government spending, PIF-linked programmes, localisation (In-Kingdom Total Value Add) and Emiratisation / Saudization targets.
Flawed strategy, failure to execute transformation programmes, M&A integration and portfolio decisions.
Obsolescence of products or services, failure to adopt digital and AI-enabled models.

domains.description_en: Risks to financial position, liquidity, capital adequacy and financial reporting integrity.
domains.description_ar: المخاطر التي تؤثر على المركز المالي والسيولة وكفاية رأس المال وسلامة التقارير المالية.

children.description_en: Default or deterioration of customers, borrowers, counterparties and government receivables.
Inability to meet obligations as they fall due; refinancing, covenant and working-capital stress.
Adverse movements in FX (non-USD-pegged exposures), SAIBOR/EIBOR, commodities and equity prices.
Erosion of capital buffers; breach of SAMA / CBUAE / QCB prudential ratios.
Material misstatement, IFRS application, ZATCA e-invoicing / VAT / zakat / corporate tax exposure, transfer pricing.
Cost overruns, margin compression and unrealised synergy assumptions.

domains.description_en: Risk of loss from inadequate or failed internal processes, people, systems, third parties or external events.
domains.description_ar: مخاطر الخسارة الناتجة عن عدم كفاية أو فشل العمليات الداخلية أو الأفراد أو الأنظمة أو الأطراف الخارجية أو الأحداث الخارجية.

children.description_en: Manual errors, process breakdowns, capacity constraints and inadequate procedures.
Vendor failure, concentration, sub-contractor performance and outsourcing arrangements subject to SAMA / CBUAE outsourcing rules.
Disruption of critical supplies, single-source dependencies, customs and localisation constraints.
Schedule slippage, scope creep, contractor performance and benefits not realised on capital and transformation programmes.
Inability to maintain critical operations through disruption (facilities, utilities, pandemic, extreme weather).
Plant, equipment and facility failure, maintenance backlogs and asset integrity.

domains.description_en: Risks arising from information technology, cyber threats, data and emerging technology adoption.
domains.description_ar: المخاطر الناشئة عن تقنية المعلومات والتهديدات السيبرانية والبيانات واعتماد التقنيات الناشئة.

children.description_en: Ransomware, intrusion, credential compromise and exfiltration; NCA ECC / SAMA CSF control gaps.
Outages of core systems, disaster recovery gaps, capacity and obsolescence.
Cloud concentration, in-Kingdom hosting requirements, CST / NCA cloud controls and cross-border transfer restrictions.
Failed changes, uncontrolled development, technical debt and ERP transformation.
Model risk, bias, unreliable outputs and SDAIA AI ethics / EU AI Act obligations.
Excessive privileges, orphan accounts and segregation-of-duties conflicts.

domains.description_en: Risks to personal and business data — protection, quality, governance and lawful processing under GCC data protection laws.
domains.description_ar: المخاطر المتعلقة بالبيانات الشخصية والتجارية من حيث الحماية والجودة والحوكمة والمعالجة المشروعة وفق قوانين حماية البيانات الخليجية.

children.name_en: Personal data protection (PDPL / UAE PDPL / QA PDPPL)
children.name_ar: حماية البيانات الشخصية (نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية)
children.description_en: Unlawful processing, consent, breach notification and data-subject rights failures.
Inaccurate, incomplete or duplicated master data driving wrong decisions and regulatory returns.
Mishandling of classified or confidential information; NDMO classification requirements.
Failure to retain evidence for statutory periods or to dispose of data securely.

domains.description_en: Risk of regulatory sanction, licence conditions and enforcement from GCC regulators and international regimes.
domains.description_ar: مخاطر العقوبات التنظيمية وشروط الترخيص والإجراءات الرقابية من الجهات التنظيمية الخليجية والأنظمة الدولية.

children.name_en: Financial sector regulation (SAMA / CBUAE / QCB / CBB)
children.name_ar: تنظيم القطاع المالي (ساما / المصرف المركزي الإماراتي / مصرف قطر المركزي)
children.description_en: Breach of prudential, conduct, outsourcing or cyber requirements of the central bank.

children.name_ar: تنظيم الأمن السيبراني (الهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني)
children.description_en: Non-compliance with national cybersecurity controls and critical-infrastructure obligations.
Disclosure, corporate governance regulation, insider dealing and related-party transaction rules.

children.name_ar: الضرائب والفوترة الإلكترونية (هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك)
children.description_en: VAT, zakat, corporate tax, e-invoicing phase obligations and customs compliance.

children.name_ar: مكافحة غسل الأموال وتمويل الإرهاب والعقوبات
children.description_en: Customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, SAR reporting and sanctions screening failures.
Commercial licensing, Saudization / Emiratisation quotas, Nitaqat, wage protection and labour law.

domains.description_en: Exposure from contracts, litigation, intellectual property and legal uncertainty.
domains.description_ar: التعرض الناشئ عن العقود والتقاضي والملكية الفكرية وعدم اليقين القانوني.

children.description_en: Unfavourable terms, unenforceable clauses, government contract and concession disputes.
Claims, arbitration and regulatory proceedings and their financial impact.
Infringement, loss of trade secrets and inadequate IP protection.
Companies-law obligations, board duties, foreign ownership and entity structuring.

domains.description_en: Environmental, social, governance and climate-related risks including transition and physical risk and sustainability disclosure.
domains.description_ar: المخاطر البيئية والاجتماعية والحوكمية والمتعلقة بالمناخ بما في ذلك مخاطر التحول والمخاطر المادية والإفصاح عن الاستدامة.

children.description_en: Extreme heat, flooding, water scarcity and their effect on operations and assets.
Carbon pricing, net-zero commitments (Saudi Green Initiative, UAE Net Zero 2050) and stranded assets.
Emissions, waste, water and permit breaches (NCEC, EAD, MoE).
Labour practices in the supply chain, worker welfare, community impact and human rights.
Inaccurate ESG disclosure under Tadawul / ADX / DFM guidance and ISSB standards.

domains.description_en: Loss of trust among customers, regulators, shareholders, government and the public.
domains.description_ar: فقدان الثقة لدى العملاء والجهات الرقابية والمساهمين والحكومة والجمهور.

children.description_en: Negative media and social-media coverage, viral incidents and public sentiment.
Service outages, mis-selling and complaint handling failures.
Loss of regulator confidence, public enforcement and exclusion from government programmes.

domains.description_en: Risks to the health and safety of employees, contractors, customers and the public.
domains.description_ar: المخاطر التي تهدد صحة وسلامة الموظفين والمقاولين والعملاء والجمهور.

children.description_en: Serious injuries, fatalities and lost-time incidents at operational sites.
Fire, explosion, toxic release and structural failure.
Midday work ban compliance, heat-related illness and long-term occupational health.
Inadequate control of contractor safety performance and permit-to-work systems.

domains.description_en: Internal and external fraud, bribery and corruption, and misconduct.
domains.description_ar: الاحتيال الداخلي والخارجي والرشوة والفساد وسوء السلوك.

children.description_en: Asset misappropriation, financial statement fraud and collusion by employees.
Business email compromise, payment diversion, identity fraud and vendor impersonation.
Improper payments, gifts and hospitality, and conflicts of interest with public officials.
Breach of code of conduct, market conduct, harassment and ineffective speak-up channels.

domains.description_en: Talent, capability, key-person dependency and culture risks.
domains.description_ar: مخاطر المواهب والقدرات والاعتماد على الأشخاص الرئيسيين والثقافة المؤسسية.

children.description_en: Inability to attract or retain scarce skills; competition from giga-projects and government entities.

children.name_ar: الاعتماد على الأشخاص الرئيسيين والتعاقب الوظيفي
children.description_en: Concentration of knowledge in individuals and weak succession plans.
Skills gaps during nationalisation of the workforce and technology transformation.
Low engagement, risk-averse or non-compliant culture and wellbeing issues.
